role: Repeated external DEV; not new independent validation

interface.name: Gate-MRA-SemProb-R1
interface.aggregation: Mean of four source-specific probabilities for each target
interface.encoder_exposure: FIT patients were previously exposed through CT; not OOF
interface.model_updates: Only fixed LR heads; no encoder update

definitions.sampled_macro_Dice: Within each scan, macro Dice over GT-or-prediction nonempty anatomical classes, then patient mean; class support can change after gating
definitions.annotation_absent_FPR: Patient mean of false presence among classes absent in the complete released annotation
definitions.corrected_points: Baseline incorrect sampled points made correct, versus the same model's NONE policy
definitions.new_error_points: Baseline correct sampled points made incorrect, versus the same model's NONE policy
definitions.any_new_error: Patients with at least one newly incorrect sampled point, versus the same model's NONE policy
definitions.rare_TP_lost: Previously correct sampled rare-branch points made incorrect, versus the same model's NONE policy
definitions.sampled_baseline_TP_branch_support_lost: Previously detected sampled true-positive branches losing all correct identity support
definitions.recall_native8: R-Pcom sampled-point recall, complete-annotation positive support
definitions.recall_native9: L-Pcom sampled-point recall, complete-annotation positive support
definitions.recall_native10: Acom sampled-point recall, complete-annotation positive support
definitions.recall_native15: third-A2 sampled-point recall, complete-annotation positive support

uncertainty.interval: Exploratory 95%; not multiplicity or repeated-development corrected
uncertainty.interpretation: A Dice increase can arise from changing the nonempty class denominator without any corrected point. Zero observed new errors does not certify safety.

decision: Retain original frozen methods. The revised semantic-probability interface has not shown an efficacy improvement or a new mechanism claim.
